title: watch callback is run twice when calling `createApp` in the callback

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Vue version

3.2.38

### Link to minimal reproduction
[SFC Playground](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the [demo](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)@vue3.2.38
2. After clicking it, two nodes will appear

![CleanShot 2022-09-07 at 15 26 02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18424466/188816102-57894915-67c3-49fd-adfa-8e84b4fc8ccd.gif)




### What is expected?

1. open the [demo](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)@vue3.2.37
2. After clicking it, one node will appear

![CleanShot 2022-09-07 at 15 24 55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18424466/188815408-f534c6aa-24c1-4a3d-894b-f342246ce93c.gif)



### What is actually happening?

Two nodes will appear!!!
